text: こうして　ならんでると　はないち　もんめ　してる　みたい
note: Hana Ichi Monme is a traditional Japanese children's game in which two rows of children hold hands, face each other and sing while picking players from the other side. The English game dropped the reference and says they must look silly.
claim: Hana Ichi Monme is a traditional Japanese children's game played by two lines of children holding hands and facing each other while singing.

check.quote: Hana Ichi Monme is a traditional Japanese children's game... Players split into two groups, and the members of each group hold hands, so that the teams face each other in two lines. One group steps toward the other in the rhythm of a song that is used only for the game
